findings.detail: FR-001's and FR-002's NFR boundary conditions were swapped: FR-001 shows the Performance TBD that nfr_spec_output attached to FR-002, and FR-002 shows the Usability condition that belongs to FR-001. Both conditions survived, but neither landed on the right requirement.
OR-01 (adoption risk) is about the approver dashboard, which is FR-002, but risks[] tags it as underlies_or_affects: ["FR-001"] — the wrong FR.

fixes_applied.description: Swapped the two NFR entries back to their correct FRs and corrected prd.md's two NFR tables to match.
Corrected the risk's underlies_or_affects to FR-002 and updated prd.md's Risks section accordingly.
